usage: 燒蝦 is a noun used to name a specific seafood dish made of grilled prawns.
You can use 燒蝦 when ordering food in a restaurant or talking about dishes.
燒蝦 can appear as the subject or object in a sentence.
When describing the taste or quality of 燒蝦, adjectives usually come before the word.
You can combine 燒蝦 with measure words like '隻 (zek3)' when counting.
